name: Berlin Defense — Tactics
description: Tactical patterns in the Berlin Wall. (Folded under Ruy Lopez Berlin — the Berlin Defense is the Berlin Variation of the Ruy Lopez.)

drills.name: The Bishop Pair
drills.description: After the queen trade in the Berlin, how does White fight for the advantage?
drills.briefExplanation: White gives up the bishop pair but damages Black's structure and heads to a favorable endgame.
drills.placementNote: Berlin Defense — folded under the Ruy Lopez Berlin parent. Standalone position; does not arise from the Ruy Lopez Berlin main line.
